THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
RUNWAY
084
STUDY 103
Monochrome Polo Knit Set, Walk
Rights check / Repeats Study 99.
Source: 25002.jpg
Crisp, graphic, sporty
WORKING NOTES
- The black trim and sneakers create the sporty contrast.
- Keep only one of sections 99 or 103 if you do not need
both.
Try this: Emphasize the black trim and sneakers.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight black hair walks a navy runway
in a white knit long-sleeve polo with
black placket trim and matching white
knit shorts with black piping. She wears
black and white lace-up sneakers and
black ankle socks. Her expression is
calm and direct. Soft stage light. Palette
of white, black, and deep navy. Crisp
and graphic, in the style of a spring
runway show. This is a near-duplicate of
section 99.
